parsed.name: 换行分隔 JSON 数据目录
parsed.description: 一种用于保存实验或机器人采集数据的记录型数据文件组件。它以每行一条 JSON 记录的形式存储数据，并配合清单元数据管理，适合顺序追加、日志化保存以及按索引定位读取记录。
parsed.description_en: A record-oriented data file component for storing experimental or robotics data. It stores one JSON object per line and works with manifest metadata, making it suitable for append-only logging and indexed access to stored records.

actions.description: 写入一条记录并更新清单。
actions.description_en: Write a record and update the manifest.
